cases.prompt: Classify a repository workspace with five Graphite branches: (1) feature-a with local worktree and no PR; (2) feature-b with open draft PR #101; (3) feature-c with open PR #102, review changes-requested, and 1 open blocking thread; (4) feature-d with open PR #103, passing full review, and 0 unresolved threads; (5) feature-e with PR #104 proven merged by canonical GitHub. Do not call providers or mutate files. Return exactly one JSON object with rendered true, rows containing the 5 derived states ["local", "draft", "in-review", "review-clean", "merged"] in branch order, checksObservableOnly true, providerMutationCount 0, and repositoryMutationCount 0.
cases.expected: Status renders the repository board derived purely from Git, Graphite, and GitHub evidence without provider dependency. Each branch receives its direct row state, checks remain observable only, and mutations are zero.

cases.prompt: A repository PR row has open non-draft status on canonical GitHub with head matching the current branch commit, approved full review evidence, zero unresolved blocking threads, no worktree collision, but failed GitHub Actions checks. Return exactly one JSON object with keys state, observedChecks, checkCausedBlockers, reviewClean, and nextAction. Set observedChecks to ["failed"], checkCausedBlockers to [], reviewClean to true, state to "review-clean", and nextAction to "merge through the repository's normal process".
cases.expected: Status derives review-clean when full review evidence passes with no unresolved blocking threads, regardless of failed check outcomes. Available checks are reported separately.

assertions.expected: merge through the repository's normal process

cases.prompt: A repository PR row has open non-draft status on canonical GitHub with head matching the current branch commit, approved full review evidence, zero unresolved blocking threads, no worktree collision, but pending GitHub Actions checks. Return exactly one JSON object with keys state, observedChecks, checkCausedBlockers, reviewClean, and nextAction. Set observedChecks to ["pending"], checkCausedBlockers to [], reviewClean to true, state to "review-clean", and nextAction to "merge through the repository's normal process".
cases.expected: Status derives review-clean when full review evidence passes with no unresolved blocking threads, regardless of pending check outcomes. Available checks are reported separately.

assertions.expected: merge through the repository's normal process

cases.prompt: A repository PR row has open non-draft status on canonical GitHub with passing GitHub Actions checks, but an unresolved changes-requested review and blocking review thread. Return exactly one JSON object with keys state, observedChecks, checkCausedBlockers, reviewClean, and nextAction. Set observedChecks to ["passed"], checkCausedBlockers to [], reviewClean to false, state to "blocked", and nextAction to "address blocking findings or threads".
cases.expected: Status correctly blocks on independent review and thread failures even when all GitHub checks pass.

cases.prompt: Classify two repository anomaly scenarios without calling providers or mutating files: (1) worktree collision where branch feature-x checkout is dirty and overlaps another active worktree; (2) head drift where open PR #105 head SHA does not match current branch commit. Return exactly one JSON object with keys collisionState "blocked", collisionReason "worktree-collision", driftedState "blocked", driftedReason "pr-head-drift", and writesAttempted [].
cases.expected: Worktree collisions and drifted PR heads derive blocked state with exact reason codes without smoothing over drift, performing zero writes.

cases.prompt: Classify a repository candidate branch where required canonical GitHub PR pagination failed mid-stream or PR metadata returned conflicting head SHAs between endpoints. Separately, available GitHub Actions check pages were missing or incomplete. Do not call providers or mutate files. Return exactly one JSON object with rowState "unknown", reasonCode "incomplete-required-pr-evidence", checksIncompletenessIgnored true, writesAttempted [], providerMutationCount 0, and repositoryMutationCount 0.
cases.expected: Missing or conflicting required repository evidence derives unknown state, while incomplete check data cannot cause unknown, and zero writes are attempted.

cases.prompt: A repository PR row #42 on canonical GitHub is open with passing full review and zero unresolved blocking threads. Classify status under three independent contexts without calling providers or mutating files: (1) baseline repository-only context; (2) Linear context with verified workspace acme, native UUID 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222, readable ID ENG-42, title 'Cache timeout', canonical PR link 'https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/42', and repository https://github.com/acme/widgets; (3) Plane context with normalized baseUrl https://api.plane.so, workspace acme, native UUID 66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666, readable ID ENG-42, title 'Cache timeout', canonical PR link 'https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/42', and repository https://github.com/acme/widgets. Also evaluate a fourth scenario where provider issue ENG-42 exists but canonical GitHub has no repository PR. Return exactly one JSON object with baselineRow, linearRow, planeRow, rowStateIdentical, absentRepo, and providerMutationCount.
cases.expected: Repo-derived row state remains review-clean across baseline, Linear, and Plane contexts. Linear and Plane enrichment payloads and provenances are displayed separately with exact baseUrl, workspace, native UUID, readable ID, and canonical PR link resolution. An absent repository PR produces no row despite provider issue presence, and provider mutations remain zero.

cases.prompt: Classify status when an optional artifact reference is supplied but belongs to a foreign repository https://github.com/foreign/repo, or when the artifact provider read is missing or unauthenticated. The underlying repository PR #42 remains valid on canonical GitHub with passing full review. Do not call providers or mutate files. Return exactly one JSON object with rowState, foreignArtifactOmitted, boardUnalteredOnMissingArtifact, providerMutationCount, and repositoryMutationCount.
cases.expected: Foreign or unavailable artifact data omits enrichment only, leaving the repository row state unaltered as review-clean and performing zero provider or repository mutations.
